name: Compresh
description: Per-turn context compression — episodic memory architecture for LLM conversations

apiKey.description: Compresh API key (sk-comp_...). Optional — without a key the plugin runs free local TULBASE compression; a key unlocks server-side TUL 2.0 (query-aware, lossless retrieval). Get one free: run `compresh-mcp signup <email>`.

endpoint.description: Override the Compresh endpoint. Default: https://api.compre.sh/v1/tul2

protectionMode.description: Number of trailing raw messages preserved without compression (2 / 4 / 8). Default: balanced.

providerHint.description: Reported in telemetry for per-provider stats. Example: anthropic, openai.

modelHint.description: Reported in telemetry for per-model stats. Example: claude-sonnet-4-5.

minMessages.description: Skip compression below this message count. Default: 6.

timeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout for the compresh-mcp compress call in milliseconds. Default: 10000.

binPath.description: Path to the compresh-mcp executable. Default: compresh-mcp (resolved on PATH). Override if installed somewhere non-standard.

binArgs.description: Extra space-separated arguments passed to the compresh-mcp subprocess. Default: none.

apiKey.label: Compresh API key
apiKey.help: Get one at https://compre.sh. Read by the compresh-mcp subprocess via COMPRESH_API_KEY.

protectionMode.label: Protection mode
protectionMode.help: Trailing raw messages preserved without compression: aggressive=2, balanced=4, conservative=8.
